You can share the MicroLab Interactive Virtual Laboratory with your M.Sc. Microbiology students in several ways. I recommend using Google Drive or your institute's LMS so students can access it easily.

Step 1: Download your module

MicroLab Interactive Virtual Lab.html

Standalone interactive HTML file

Download the virtual lab

Step 2: Choose how to share it

Option 1 — Google Drive (easy for distributing the file)

  1. Download the HTML file above.

  2. Open Google Drive.

  3. Upload the file using New → File upload.

  4. Right-click the uploaded file and choose Share.

  5. Change General access to Anyone with the link if your institute permits it.

  6. Copy the link and send it to your students.

Important: Drive's preview may not run the interactive module. Students may need to download the HTML file and open it in Chrome or Edge.

Option 2 — Make it open directly in a browser

Use GitHub Pages to publish the HTML file as a small website. Students can then open a web link without downloading the file. This requires a GitHub account and a few setup steps.

Option 3 — Share through WhatsApp or your class group

Send the downloaded HTML file as a document, or share the Google Drive link. Tell students to download the file and open it in a browser rather than viewing it inside WhatsApp.
